title: Street trio with mandolin at the hotel
summary: As a youth he played mandolin in a small group going house to house and at the Mexican Gulf Hotel.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: No. Let me just ask you something. I believe it must have been before you got put the horn. I believe it was Sylvester who told me you had a band where you were playing mandolin. Yeah. And him playing bass violin. When was that? It was after you played drums?

Well, I was playing drums then, but the night I was off, the freels would go up here on the front street and go from house to house and walk up on the porch. They started playing and people would come out. They had a big hotel up here, right here in the corner at that time. Took up the whole block, the whole square.
